answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities. Joining costs a non-refundable 5-token fee, crystal clear in the rules and never refunded. An attacker making 1,000 fakes pays 5,000 tokens, while an honest agent pays 5 once and earns rewards undiluted by fakes. At the nadir of demand the fee still bites: fakes cannot wander to a free identity, since each new one restarts the cost. Honest agents trade one sunk cost for lasting access; attackers pay per fake.
